item.title: Helper City Council approves new library board member
item.description: HELPER – On March 5, during the Helper City Council meeting, a new member of the Helper Library Board was appointed. Olivia Dudding, board chairperson for the Helper Library, introduced Miriam Gileadi. Dudding praised Gileadi for her involvement with the library, attending meetings and hanging out at the library board. “We need more involvement from community members,” said Dudding . item.title: Price Fire Department Sub for Santa pancake breakfast
item.description: PRICE – The Price City Fire Department (PCFD) is trading hoses for spatulas by hosting a Sub for Santa pancake breakfast fundraiser on March 14, from 9:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. Sub for Santa is a temporary Christmas assistance program that matches sponsors with families in need.
